entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was eleven years old, tall and had curly brown hair.
entries.zh: 他十一岁，个子很高，长着棕色卷发。

entries.zh: 那男子已到中年，脸上皱纹密布，透着狡黠。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Even though he must have been in his seventies, he was still running five miles a day.
entries.zh: 虽然他想必已有七十多岁，却仍每天跑五英里。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: John was short, squat and as broad as a bull.
entries.zh: 约翰矮胖结实，像公牛一样宽壮。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A small man, with stumpy little legs, shuffled towards them.
entries.zh: 一个小个子男子拖着短粗的双腿向他们走来。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The girl was elfin, but surprisingly strong for someone so small.
entries.zh: 那女孩精灵般娇小，力气却大得令人吃惊。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Ann was of average height and had a lean, athletic build.
entries.zh: 安身高中等，体格精瘦，充满运动感。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was big for his age, with broad, muscular shoulders.
entries.zh: 他比同龄人高大，双肩宽阔，肌肉发达。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The tall, lanky teenager used his long legs to intercept the ball.
entries.zh: 那个瘦高少年利用自己的长腿截住了球。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The doorway was blocked by an enormous giant of a man, with huge, powerful shoulders and legs like tree trunks.
entries.zh: 一名巨人般魁梧的男子堵住门口，肩膀宽厚有力，双腿粗如树干。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He shivered as he looked up at the human pyramid towering over him.
entries.zh: 他抬头望着面前高耸的人形金字塔，不禁打了个寒战。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Body, build, legs, shoulders, chest, stomach, belly, arms; Chin, neck, face; Skin, pouch, folds, muscles; China doll, rake, stick, skeleton; Bull, ox, wrestler, rugby forward
entries.zh: 身体、体格、腿、肩膀、胸膛、腹部、肚子、手臂；下巴、颈部、脸；皮肤、袋状物、褶皱、肌肉；瓷娃娃、耙子、棍子、骨架；公牛、牛、摔跤手、橄榄球前锋。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Huge, enormous, massive; Chubby, plump, pot-bellied, flabby, fleshy, obese; Slim, slender, slight, petite, elfin; Bony, skinny, weedy, scrawny, spindly, skeletal, gaunt, emaciated, haggard; Broad, square, burly, strong, powerful, muscular; Athletic, dainty, graceful; Stooped, hunched, crooked; Upright, straight-backed, erect
entries.zh: 巨大、硕大、魁梧；圆胖、丰满、大腹便便、松垮、多肉、肥胖；苗条、修长、纤细、娇小、精灵般纤小；瘦骨嶙峋、皮包骨、瘦弱、干瘦、细长、骨架般、憔悴消瘦、极度消瘦、形容枯槁；宽厚、方正、壮实、强壮、有力、肌肉发达；健美、娇巧、优雅；驼背、弓背、弯曲；挺直、腰背笔直、直立。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Stood, walked, moved, ran, shuffled, hobbled; Hung, wobbled, flapped, slumped; Hunched
entries.zh: 站立、行走、移动、跑、拖步走、蹒跚；垂挂、晃动、扑动、瘫垂；弓背。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Santa Claus is a jolly, pot-bellied man with a white beard.
entries.zh: 圣诞老人是个留着白胡子、乐呵呵且大腹便便的人。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her huge pot-belly hung over her trousers like an enormous skin pouch.
entries.zh: 她硕大的肚腩像一个巨大的皮囊，垂在裤腰上。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was short and plump, and cosy like a well-padded cushion.
entries.zh: 她矮胖而柔软，像填得厚厚的软垫，让人觉得舒服。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The skin on her arms was loose and flapped like huge, fleshy wings.
entries.zh: 她手臂上的皮肤松弛，像巨大的肉翅一样晃动。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His chins hung in massive folds, covering his neck and slumping onto his chest.
entries.zh: 他层层叠叠的下巴肉遮住了脖子，一直垂到胸前。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was short, fat and so flabby his stomach wobbled when he walked.
entries.zh: 他又矮又胖，赘肉松垮，走路时肚子一颤一颤的。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: For someone so short and dumpy, he was very fast on his feet.
entries.zh: 别看他矮小敦实，脚下却十分灵活。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gymnast was a petite, dainty woman.
entries.zh: 这位体操运动员是个娇小玲珑的女子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was slim and dainty and walked gracefully like a ballet dancer.
entries.zh: 她身材苗条娇巧，步态像芭蕾舞者一样优雅。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The girl was tiny and delicate like a china doll.
entries.zh: 那女孩娇小精致，像个瓷娃娃。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The fragile boy looked as if a gust of wind would bend him in half.
entries.zh: 那纤弱的男孩仿佛一阵风就会被吹得折成两半。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was a tall, scrawny boy with a face like a weasel.
entries.zh: 他是个瘦高的男孩，脸像黄鼠狼一样尖瘦。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was so emaciated he looked like a walking skeleton.
entries.zh: 他极度消瘦，像一具会走路的骷髅。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert was a tall, thin stick of a man, with hips that stood out like two tusks.
entries.zh: 罗伯特高瘦得像根竹竿，髋骨像两根獠牙一样突出。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She was old, stooped and painfully thin. Every step, every painful shuffle, took every ounce of her strength.
entries.zh: 她年迈驼背，瘦得令人心疼。每走一步，每艰难地挪动一下，都要耗尽全身力气。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was tall and scrawny like a plucked chicken, with horrid, bony hands and long, clawed fingers.
entries.zh: 他高瘦得像只拔了毛的鸡，双手瘦骨嶙峋，长长的手指像爪子一样吓人。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her skin hung in creased folds around her neck and arms, as if she had shrunk inside it.
entries.zh: 她脖子和手臂上的皮肤皱皱地松垂着，仿佛身子在皮囊里缩小了。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His father was as broad as a bull and burly like a rugby forward.
entries.zh: 他的父亲像公牛一样宽壮，像橄榄球前锋一样结实。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert may have had a slim body, but he had broad, powerful shoulders and muscular arms and legs.
entries.zh: 罗伯特虽然身形瘦长，却有宽厚有力的肩膀和肌肉发达的四肢。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Slim and athletic, Kitty ran with a natural rhythm.
entries.zh: 基蒂身材苗条健美，跑起来节奏自然。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Robert was old and stooped and could only walk with the aid of a walking stick.
entries.zh: 罗伯特年迈驼背，只能拄着拐杖行走。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: An old tramp hobbled towards the bench. He was frail, crumpled and hunched like a question mark.
entries.zh: 一位老流浪汉蹒跚着走向长凳。他虚弱衰老，弓背的样子像个问号。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He was tall and thin and stood straight-backed like a soldier.
entries.zh: 他又高又瘦，像军人一样挺直腰背站着。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She stood erect, her head held high, with the air of someone who was used to being obeyed.
entries.zh: 她昂首挺立，带着一种习惯于别人服从自己的气势。
